items.html: The reason how, from this third of Tiferet alone, three Mochin were made in ZA, is this: it was explained above how the lower third of Tiferet of Arich rose and clothed the two upper thirds of Arich’s own Tiferet. Afterward the Yesod of Arich also rose and clothed the lower third of the aforementioned Tiferet, and was included within the whole of it.
